incidentbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: paging-proxy returned 401 on outbound page deliveries for service="inference-router-prod" (3 failures). request_id=aa3f2c. auto-suppression=off

nora (oncall): seeing the alert, will check. did anyone rotate keys for pager-proxy today?

mike (sre): not me. quick curl to the webhook returns 401. attaching snippet.

mike (sre): ```
$ curl -v -X POST https://pager-proxy.internal/api/v1/page -H 'Authorization: Signature keyId="pager-proxy-key",algorithm="hmac-sha256",headers="(request-target) date"' -d '{"to":"+1...","body":"test"}'
* HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
* {"error":"invalid signature","code":401}
```

sara (pm): customers on inference-router-prod might be impacted? any 5xx spikes on the console?

mike (sre): checking metrics — 5xx token errors spiked ~09:12 -> 09:24 UTC, correlated with paging failures. setting alert to severity=page.

tom (infra): I just checked signing key rotation logs for pager-proxy. there was an automated key rollover at 09:10 but the cache flush to edge proxies failed (timeout). looks like edge still using old key so signatures rejected.

nora (oncall): ok that explains it. immediate mitigation: can we force edge proxies to accept old key OR roll back rotation? which is safer?

tom (infra): fastest is to add the old key back into the verification list on edge (accept both keys) and restart proxy workers. doing that now.

devops-bot: executed: `infractl proxy add-verify-key --proxy edge-*/ --key-id old-key-2026-03-17` (job id: j-87a)

mike (sre): after adding old key, I'm re-sending a test page — got 200 now.

mike (sre): ```
* HTTP/1.1 200 OK
* {"status":"queued","page_id":"p_12345"}
```

nora (oncall): manual escalation to PD sent for any unacked pages between 09:10-09:25. @sara please confirm customer comms if needed. :phone:

sara (pm): will draft a short blurb: apologize, note transient paging & routing impact, mention mitigation and ETA for postmortem. will post if customers ask.

tom (infra): root cause: key rollover automation attempted to push new verify keys but the edge cache flush RPC timed out. failing change was retried once then marked done. timeline attached in infra logs. will open a PR to make retry behavior stricter and ensure circuit-breaker doesn't mark success on partial deploy.

mike (sre): impact estimate: ~18 pages failed to be delivered to on-call between 09:11-09:23; no known missed incident escalations because we detected failures and people were manually paged. recommend follow-up: (1) make key propagation atomic, (2) instrumentation to detect 'verify key mismatch' and auto-fallback to accept previous key for 5 minutes, (3) run a tabletop to exercise key rotations.

nora (oncall): thanks. I manually paged affected teams at 09:20-09:27. please add that to the timeline. we should also add a runbook step: if pager-proxy returns 401 -> check key-rotation job and fallback accept-old-key.

sara (pm): adding action items to tickets. I'll coordinate customer comms if any support tickets pop.

tom (infra): created infra ticket: INFRA-2459 "pager-proxy key propagation: improve atomicity + retries". assigned to me, ETA M5 (two weeks).

mike (sre): putting a short mitigation hotfix: will make key-rotation job verify cache flush across 3 regions before marking complete. pushing patch to staging.

nora (oncall): marking this thread resolved for now since pages restored and manual escalations covered. please add any postmortem notes to INC-1799990000.

incidentbot: Incident incident-1799990000 created, status=resolved, timeline_start=1799990000, timeline_end=1799990234. :white_check_mark:
